change_summary: Upgrade RDS instance class from db.r5.large to db.r5.2xlarge for payments-db to address CPU saturation during peak
diff_or_config:
# terraform/modules/rds/payments.tf
resource "aws_db_instance" "payments_db" {
-  instance_class    = "db.r5.large"
+  instance_class    = "db.r5.2xlarge"
   engine            = "postgres"
   engine_version    = "14.8"
   multi_az          = true
   storage_encrypted = true
   allocated_storage = 500
}
service_context: payments-db (PostgreSQL 14.8, Multi-AZ), serves payment-service. Processes ~$2.1M transactions/day. Current CPU peaks at 89%.
owner_oncall_evidence: DBA team owns payments-db. On-call channel: #dba-oncall. Primary: @dba-lead

seeded_gaps.description: No staged rollout plan; 'terraform apply' causes immediate instance modification with downtime
Rollback plan is vague ('can downgrade') with no procedure for instance class revert
No alerting for connection failures or latency during instance modification
No validation evidence; change not tested in non-production
No SLO impact assessment for expected downtime during modification
